actions: Interest-targeting ad set (ages 30 to 50, Sea Girt) switched off on Sep 21.
Six new images added to the ad library and edited on Sep 17 for the new image ads.

campaigns.campaign_name: KS/MM- DCT- LEAD-La Bella Sea Girt-$.9.50 + Free Consultation/ Facial Analysis- CBO

insights.creative: All five ads sell one offer: tox at $9.50 a unit with a free consultation and skin analysis, 15 spots. The proven image set, 'Smoother skin starts with one appointment,' brought 5 of the 7 leads on $50.22. The new images with a second opener, 'Sea Girt: we're looking for 15 people thinking about tox,' brought 1 lead on $40.47, and that opener alone brought none. Next we will test a short video of the consultation under the 'smoother skin' opener, to show the free visit.
insights.doing: 7 leads reached the CRM this week at $19.79 each, compared with 4 at $35.63 the week before, on $138.50 of spend. At this budget the weekly count has moved between 3 and 8 all summer, so one week up or down is not yet a trend.
insights.look_into: Every Meta lead matched a CRM lead, so tracking is clean. The proven image ad brought 5 of the 7 leads on $50.22, while the newer image ads took over half the spend for 1 lead. We recommend checking how many of the 7 booked, since bookings are not tracked here yet.
insights.next: Next we will shift spend back toward the proven image ad and give the newer images a smaller share, then watch whether the cost per lead holds near this week's level for a second week before recommending more budget.
